recipes.name: Chickpea Omelette Sandwich
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the ground flaxseeds and water. Set aside for 5 minutes to gel.
Add the remaining omelette ingredients, using only half of the bell pepper and onion. Reserve the other half for serving. Mix well.
Heat some oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of the omelette mixture to the pan per omelette.
Once golden on the bottom, flip the omelettes and cook on the other side. Repeat until all the batter is used up.
Spread some mayo on each slice of bread. Top with the omelette, lettuce, tomato, avocado, and the remaining raw bell pepper and onion. Garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Kala namak, also known as Himalayan black salt, is a salt often used in South Asian cuisine. The sulphur compounds give the salt an egg-like smell and flavour, which makes it perfect to use in an omelette like this one.
Storage The omelette can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
